scope: Website-only local source and browser rescan. External backend read-only; separate apps excluded; no deployment or real submissions.
notes: Snapshot groups include the diagnostic scan and targeted rechecks; final shared selector assertions supersede earlier border-color observations.
Screenshots and runners remain in the local ignored tmp/form-audit tree. Backend, auth, SMS, postcode and payment boundaries are mocked or blocked in fixtures.
The final phone behavior keeps the OTP input and entered code visible when clearing/changing the phone; mismatched numbers cannot confirm.

checks: clearing number keeps OTP visible and preserves entered code
different and foreign numbers keep OTP visible but block confirmation
new challenge binds to updated UK number and starts empty
